title: Explore Digital Crown, Trackpad, and iPad pointer automation
description: Learn how you can interact with devices in UI Tests in Xcode 13. Discover newly-automatable input methods including iPadOS pointer, watchOS Digital Crown, and enhanced macOS trackpad scrolling APIs.

codeSnippets.title: New supportsPointerInteraction property on XCUIDevice
New methods on XCUIElement and XCUICoordinate for pointer interactions on iOS
codeSnippets.code:
extension XCUIElement {
  open func hover()

  open func click()

  open func rightClick()

  open func doubleClick()

  open func scroll(byDeltaX: CGFloat, deltaY: CGFloat)

  open func click(forDuration: TimeInterval, thenDragToElement: XCUIElement)

  open func click(forDuration: TimeInterval, thenDragToElement: XCUIElement,
                  withVelocity: XCUIGestureVelocity, thenHoldForDuration: TimeInterval)

  open class func perform(withKeyModifiers flags: XCUIElement.KeyModifiers,
                          block: () -> Void)
}
